tagline.en_US: Authentik is an open-source identity provider and access platform. This recipe follows the official three-service deployment with PostgreSQL, the server and a worker, each in its own Proxmox OCI LXC.

description.en_US: authentik is an open-source Identity Provider for single sign-on. It supports authentication protocols including SAML, OAuth2, OIDC, LDAP, and RADIUS. The application handles identity and access management for environments ranging from small labs to large production clusters.
